highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.1 includes GPU rendering corrections for transformed shapes, flush handling, and native clip recording.
highlights_body: These fixes retain the Skia m156 engine and leave the managed API unchanged.

bullets.lead: Correct transformed ellipses and rounded rectangles
bullets.detail: Corrects transformed stroke widths and rounded-rectangle radii, including quarter-turn transforms. Corner radii are clamped to half the device-space bounds to prevent overlap.

bullets.lead: Keep Ganesh atlas work aligned with flushes
bullets.detail: Fixes stale flush tracking after empty GPU flushes so atlas work from one flush is not treated as pending in a later flush.

The bundled engine accounts for pending clips when checking render-pass capacity and avoids double-counting recorded clips. A draw whose full clip stack cannot fit in a fresh pass is warned about and skipped rather than exceeding capacity.
